title: Stitching Starlight into Hats
blurb: Gloovi hums while threading glowing thread through a hat brim, suspended mid-air by her fingertips.

title: Cafe Corner with a Cat
blurb: She sips herbal tea at a sunlit café, her lap cat batting at loose lace from her dress.

title: Window Shopping in Rain-Slicked Streets
blurb: Gloovi skips down a wet sidewalk, umbrella tucked under her arm as she eyes a boutique window.

title: Dancing with a Dandelion
blurb: She twirls barefoot in a field of wildflowers, one hand brushing the petals as she spins.

title: Midnight Market Lights
blurb: Gloovi’s coat flutters as she steps off the train into a cobblestone square lit by lanterns and street musicians.

title: Gloovi’s Raincoat Moment
blurb: She pulls a wide-brimmed hat low over her eyes and tucks her lace dress inside a long, velvet coat as rain begins to fall.

title: The Baker’s Window
blurb: Gloovi leans into a bakery window, watching warm bread rise as steam curls from the oven — her fingers tap on glass.

title: Sitting by the Clock
blurb: She sits cross-legged on a bench beneath an old clock tower, sketching cap designs in her notebook as pigeons circle.

title: Cap in Hand, Lights Out
blurb: Gloovi stops at dusk by a flickering lamppost, cap dangling from her fingers as she smiles up at the stars.

title: Wine and Whimsy, Rooftop
blurb: Gloovi leans over a stone parapet at twilight, one hand cradling a wine glass as she watches the sky blush.

title: Cap’s Final Stitch
blurb: Gloovi sits cross-legged on a mossy bench, threading needle and humming as moonlight spills over her shoulders.

title: Gone with the Glow
blurb: Gloovi stands barefoot on a dewy bridge at dawn, cap tucked under her arm as mist curls around her ankles.

title: Cap’s Last Thread
blurb: Gloovi stops at a dusty attic window, sunlight catching the lace of her dress as she traces a pattern in the air with her fingertip.

title: Twilight’s Lullaby
blurb: She sits cross-legged on a mossy stone bench, cap tucked under her arm, humming as fireflies blink around her bare feet.

title: Woven Into the Night
blurb: Gloovi leans against a lantern-lit bridge railing, her dress glowing faintly as moonlight spills over the river below.

title: The Weaver’s Final Thread
blurb: Gloovi stands atop a spiral staircase, cap perched high on her head, one arm raised as if casting the last stitch into the wind.

title: Rain-Slicked Library
blurb: She peeks around the corner of a bookshelf, grinning as she spots a glowing stained-glass cat on the third floor.

title: Sunlit Rooftop Hideaway
blurb: She leans back on a velvet cushion, sipping tea as the sun warms her shoulders — and the city sprawls below.

title: Night Market Surprise
blurb: She twirls under a paper lantern, laughing as she dodges a vendor’s spinning umbrella — and catches her own reflection in it.

title: Window of a Coffee Shop
blurb: She’s perched on the windowsill, sketching steam curls from her mug — and the barista waves hello with a grin.

title: Morning Station
blurb: Mara’s raincoat is dry now, and she sips tea from a chipped mug as dawn spills gold over the platform—she’s here early to catch the first train of the day.

title: Dining Car Surprise
blurb: Mara’s coat is off now—she’s in a cozy vest and scarf, laughing as the conductor hands her a plate of warm bread with butter. She’s not waiting for anyone anymore.

title: The Baggage Car
blurb: Mara’s boots are muddy now, and she’s perched on a crate with a flashlight in hand—she’s looking under the train car where someone left behind a suitcase with her initials.

title: Rain Again, But Different
blurb: Mara’s raincoat is back on—this time with a fox-print scarf tucked under her arm. She’s walking toward the station door as a new train pulls in behind her, steam curling like a promise.

title: She Found the Key
blurb: Mara turns a rusted key in an old door’s lock—warm light spills out as she steps into a forgotten bakery.

title: The Cat’s Tale
blurb: A ginger cat curls in Mara’s lap as she sits cross-legged on a porch swing, rain misting the streetlamp glow.

title: Late Night Surprise
blurb: Mara leans against a brick wall in the alley, raincoat hood up—she smiles as a warm mug steams beside her.

title: The Last Light
blurb: Mara stands alone on a bridge at dusk, raincoat flapping—she turns to watch the last train vanish into mist.

title: She Finds Her Umbrella
blurb: Mara stops at a lamppost as a stray umbrella clatters to the cobblestones — she picks it up, smiling, its handle warm from someone’s hand.

title: The Clock Strikes Nine
blurb: Mara leans against a bakery doorframe, watching the hour hand creep past nine — the shopkeeper waves her inside with a wink.

title: Her Boots Are Dry Now
blurb: Mara sits on a windowsill in a sunlit attic, boots propped up — she’s changed into warm socks and is sipping tea from a chipped mug.

title: The Map Is Smudged, But She’s Home
blurb: Mara stands at the edge of the old town square, map tucked under her arm — she turns to wave goodbye to a neighbor who just pulled out a pie.

title: Coffee & Clouds
blurb: Tomas sips black coffee at an outdoor cafe as rain patters the awning, his coat still warm from a brisk walk.

title: Window Watcher
blurb: He leans against a library window, fingers tracing the glass as he watches pigeons on the street below.

title: Book in Hand
blurb: Tomas reads a worn copy of 'The Little Prince' under an awning, sunlight catching the dust on his coat sleeve.

title: Clock Tower Pause
blurb: He stands at the base of a clock tower, one hand raised to shield his eyes from the late afternoon sun.

title: Morning Coffee & Mist
blurb: Tomas sips lukewarm coffee on a damp station bench as dawn bleeds gold through fogged glass windows.

title: The Latecomer’s Apology
blurb: A woman in a trench coat hurries past, tripping over her own bag — Tomas offers his hand with a raised eyebrow.

title: The Train’s Last Whistle
blurb: Tomas watches the last carriage roll past, coat flapping like a flag — he adjusts his collar and tucks the letter away.

title: Bodega & Broken Alarm
blurb: Tomas buys a warm croissant from a sleepy vendor — the alarm clock ticks 6:17, and he’s already half an hour late.

title: He Paused at the Bell
blurb: Tomas stops beside a weathered bell tower just as dusk paints the rooftops gold, his grey coat catching the last light like a quiet confession.

title: Coffee & Clouds
blurb: Tomas sits cross-legged on a café step, sipping from a chipped mug while the last streetlamp flickers — his coat’s collar turned up against the cooling air.

title: The Bookshop’s Secret
blurb: Tomas leans against a glass door, peering into the dim glow of a bookstore — his coat open now to reveal an old leather-bound book tucked beneath his arm.

title: He Left the Key Behind
blurb: Tomas walks away from a wooden door, his grey coat brushing the handle as he pauses — just once — before turning to leave it unlocked.

title: Midnight Rooftop Watch

title: Coffee Shop Window Seat
blurb: Rook sits hunched over a steaming mug, eyes narrowed at a sketchbook while rain taps the window behind him.

title: Sunrise Library Stacks
blurb: Rook stands between towering bookshelves, one hand brushing a dusty spine as golden light spills through high windows.

title: Balcony with a Book and Cat
blurb: Rook leans against rail, holding an open novel while a ginger cat curls on his lap, watching birds fly past.

title: Coffee Break at Dawn
blurb: Rook sips black coffee while staring into the steam, his tattooed forearms resting on a worn wooden table.

title: Window Lounger
blurb: Rook leans against a sunlit windowsill, watching rain streak the glass as he taps his temple with one finger.

title: Staircase Stroll
blurb: Rook walks up a spiral staircase, one hand on the railing while the other hangs loose as he glances back over his shoulder.

title: Bookshop Study
blurb: Rook sits cross-legged on a rug, brows furrowed as he reads a thick book under the glow of a desk lamp.

title: Dawn’s First Light
blurb: Rook Vantablack stands alone on the platform as dawn bleeds gold over the rails, his coat collar turned up against the chill.

title: Coffee and a Cigarette
blurb: Rook Vantablack leans against the bench, one hand gripping a steaming mug while smoke curls from his lips as he watches the arriving train.

title: The Latecomer’s Arrival
blurb: A woman with a suitcase steps off the train, and Rook Vantablack watches her approach without moving — eyes sharp, posture still.

title: Backpack & Breadcrumbs
blurb: Rook Vantablack crouches to tie his bootlace, a backpack slung over one shoulder as he glances up at the platform clock — 7:12 AM.

title: Coffee and Curiosity
blurb: Rook sips black coffee at a dim café corner while scanning a local newspaper’s classifieds.

title: Sunrise on the Docks
blurb: Rook stands at the water’s edge as dawn breaks over the harbor, coat flapping slightly in breeze.

title: The Bookshop Surprise
blurb: Rook leans against a bookshelf, thumbing through a worn copy of ‘The Martian’ while a barista hands him a pastry.

title: Cafe Table, Two Figures
blurb: Rook and a stranger sit opposite each other over steaming mugs — the stranger gestures while Rook listens with crossed arms.

title: Rain on the Roof
blurb: Rook Vantablack stands under a porch awning as rain streaks down, his arms folded over his chest while he watches the last light fade behind rooftops.

title: Café at Dusk
blurb: Rook Vantablack leans back in a worn armchair, sipping coffee while the café’s glow spills over his tattooed forearms and the steam curls near his lips.

title: Barefoot on the Bridge
blurb: Rook Vantablack stands barefoot atop a stone bridge at twilight, arms spread wide as he lets the wind ruffle his hair and cool his skin.

title: Final Light Fades
blurb: Rook Vantablack kneels in the grass at the edge of a quiet park, hands cupped around his face as he watches the last golden ray slip behind the trees.

title: Silent Watch at Dusk
blurb: Rook stands atop the stone bridge, watching the last light bleed over the rooftops as a lone crow lands beside him.

title: Coffee in the Alley
blurb: He leans against a brick wall, sipping dark coffee from a chipped mug as steam curls around his shaved head.

title: Moon Over the Train Tracks
blurb: Rook crouches by rusted rails, tracing a glowing graffiti tag with his finger as moonlight spills across his tattooed forearms.

title: Books and Silence
blurb: He sits cross-legged on a worn wooden bench, holding an open book with both hands as shadows stretch long behind him.
